claims.claim: Canary /search p99 latency is 656ms versus 193ms for stable /search.
18 of 729 canary /search requests took over 400ms, while 0 of 2273 stable /search requests did.
Neither version returned any 5xx response during the test.
The slow canary /search requests occur in every 30s window of the test: 7, 2, 5, 4.
Canary /search is bimodal: excluding the slow tail its maximum is 190ms, and the tail cluster starts at 633ms.
